model_annotation: The diagram illustrates the frequency of responses to measures considered effective in limiting the "hidden economy" in a country. The horizontal axis represents the percentage of responses, ranging from 0 to 13%, with intervals of 1% marked, although not all are labeled, and is labeled with numerical values. The vertical axis lists various measures in Bulgarian, presented in descending order based on the percentage of responses. The bars are colored, with red indicating the top three responses and blue indicating the remaining responses. The top three measures are "Да се подобри качеството на административните..." at 13%, "Да се ограничи действията на мафията" at 10%, and "Да се повиши ефективността на съдебната система" at 9%, while the other measures range from 2% to 5%.
